name: Antenociticus

attributes.attribute: a British god known only at a single site, the genius loci of Benwell
site of his excavated temple in Condercum

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Antenociticus is a British god. A temple dedicated to him was excavated at Benwell in Condercum. Like many other Celtic gods, he is known only at a single site. He may have been the genius loci, the guardian spirit of the place.
